propositions: Bare substring containment in upstream-URL assertion accepts lookalike hosts (prefix-style notpandoc.org, suffix-style pandoc.org.evil.com) that do not actionably point at upstream.
The assertion must be replaced with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead to establish explicit end-of-host boundaries, rejecting both lookalike classes.
New regex pattern rejects suffix lookalike https://pandoc.org.evil.com and prefix lookalike https://notpandoc.org while accepting valid upstream URLs.
CodeQL alert #88 must be resolved by the fix without dismissal, verified by re-analysis clearing the alert on the default branch.
